eval_meta.about: Two-stage retrieval measure-first probe: bge dense (A) vs bge retrieve top-K + Core ML cross-encoder rerank (B). SYNTHETIC-but-representative (Claude-authored labels), directional build/no-build evidence, NOT ground-truth production data.
eval_meta.compute_units: ComputeUnit.ALL (ANE-eligible; latency is measured end-to-end, never a claim any op ran on the ANE)

metric_defs.recall@k: avg over queries of |relevant in top-k| / |relevant|
metric_defs.success@k: avg over queries of 1[any relevant in top-k]
metric_defs.MRR: mean reciprocal rank of the first relevant fact
metric_defs.nDCG@10: avg over queries of DCG@10 / ideal-DCG@10 (binary gain)
metric_defs.dense_recall@K: avg over queries of |relevant in dense top-K| / |relevant| — the ceiling a rerank of depth K can recover to (rerank reorders, never retrieves)

A_dense.name: bge dense cosine over all facts (shipped behavior)

verdict.call: GO: the cross-encoder rerank MEASURABLY improves ranking (best at K=20); ship it config-gated on top of the bge bi-encoder as the standard two-stage stack.
verdict.honesty: SYNTHETIC-but-representative eval, directional evidence not a production guarantee. recall@k (k<=K) after rerank is bounded by dense_recall@K. Latency is measured end-to-end under ComputeUnit.ALL; ANE-eligible, never claimed to run on the ANE.

REFRESHED_ON_THE_SHIPPED_CONFIG.when: 2026-07-30, quiet machine, HF_HOME pointed at the DEPLOYED cache
REFRESHED_ON_THE_SHIPPED_CONFIG.why: the committed latency figures predate the ANE short-graph fast path and understated the shipped system by ~6x

quality_unchanged.note: IDENTICAL to the committed run at four decimals on every metric - independent confirmation, on the real retrieval harness rather than a synthetic probe, that the short graph changes speed and not results

REFRESHED_ON_THE_SHIPPED_CONFIG.METHODOLOGY_TRAP_WORTH_KNOWING: running this eval WITHOUT HF_HOME set measures the DEV cache (~/.cache/huggingface), which does not carry the short graph and is a DIFFERENT configuration from what ships. The first re-run reported 11.04 ms/pair - unchanged from the old committed figure - and looked like the fast path did nothing.

PHASE2_HEADROOM_FINDING.observation: this eval set is SATURATED. Dense alone reaches success@5 = 1.0; with reranking success@3 = 1.0, MRR 0.9861 and nDCG@10 0.9841. The only metric with visible room is recall@1 at 0.8657, over 36 queries.
PHASE2_HEADROOM_FINDING.consequence: tuning retrieval against this set would be optimizing a benchmark at its ceiling, where movement is noise on 36 synthetic authored queries. Phase 2 as scoped - fusion weights, candidate K, query rewriting - has no measurable headroom HERE.
PHASE2_HEADROOM_FINDING.what_would_be_needed: a larger and harder eval set, ideally from real usage rather than authored labels. That is real work in its own right and should not be smuggled in as a tuning pass.
